title: Oozy Mexican Corn Sopes
description: Fermented, crumbly corn sopes topped with dill pickles and fresh corn, cooked in a clay pot for a weeknight Mexican treat.

ingredients.name: fermented masa
ingredients.notes: made by soaking corn flour overnight

instructions: Combine masa harina, fermented masa, and salt in a bowl.
Add warm water and olive oil, mix until dough forms.
Knead the dough until smooth, then cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a thick disk.
Preheat a clay pot over medium heat, then lightly oil the inside.
Place the disks in the pot, cook 4-5 minutes per side until golden and slightly crisp.
Top each sopes with fresh corn, diced dill pickles, and lime zest.
Serve warm, optionally with a squeeze of lime juice.
